# Pull Request

Review the complete project history and SDLC artifacts.

Create a Pull Request description containing exactly these sections:

## Summary

Provide a 2-3 sentence overview of what was built and why.

## Changes Made

Provide a bullet list of every added or modified file and explain why.

## Test Evidence

Include the actual test results or CI evidence.

Do not fabricate test results.

## Known Limitations

Include anything marked "Not Found", unresolved issue, or explicitly
out-of-scope functionality.

## Reviewer Checklist

Create a checklist covering:

- [ ] Requirements reviewed
- [ ] Architecture reviewed
- [ ] Design review completed
- [ ] Implementation plan completed
- [ ] Code review completed
- [ ] Unit tests passed
- [ ] Integration tests passed
- [ ] Documentation verified
- [ ] No secrets committed
- [ ] Known limitations reviewed

Also generate an appropriate changelog entry.

Do not claim tests passed unless they were actually executed.
